attractions.name: Hingol National Park
attractions.description: Pakistan's largest national park, spanning desert, mountains, and coastline, home to the Hingol River, mud volcanoes, and diverse wildlife.

attractions.name: Princess of Hope rock formation
attractions.description: A striking natural rock formation resembling a face, a famous landmark along the Makran Coastal Highway within Hingol National Park.

attractions.name: Kund Malir Beach
attractions.description: A remote, pristine beach along the Makran Coastal Highway, popular for its dramatic desert-meets-sea scenery.

food_places.name: Coastal highway food stalls
food_places.specialty: Fresh seafood and traditional Balochi dishes along the coastal highway

weather_info.climate_type: Warm coastal climate, hot and humid summers

seasonal_notes.avg_condition: Warm and pleasant, 18-28°C, ideal for coastal visits

travel_tips.tip: Check seasonal conditions before visiting Lasbela — mountain districts can have snow-blocked roads in winter, desert districts are extremely hot in summer.
Intercity coaches and shared vans connect most district towns to Quetta; travel times can be long given Balochistan's size.
Check current local travel advisories before visiting, as conditions can vary across Balochistan's districts.

history.founded: Historic seat of a former princely state, now Balochistan's gateway district from Karachi
history.city_history: Lasbela was historically a princely state ruled by the Jam of Lasbela, and today is home to Hingol National Park, one of Pakistan's largest protected areas, and scenic coastal formations along the Makran Coastal Highway.
history.province_history: Balochistan is Pakistan's largest province by area and least populated, historically home to the Baloch and Pashtun peoples and the site of the ancient Mehrgarh civilization (one of the earliest farming settlements in South Asia). It was ruled by the Khanate of Kalat before acceding to Pakistan in 1948, and remains known for its vast deserts, mountain ranges, and long Arabian Sea coastline.
